module: "Shoulder-mounted" camera filter: the aiming direction follows the target through a damped spring and the horizon tilts slightly according to the force (hand-held camera effect). Hidden module (isFilter, hidden). Returns a constructor.
notes: The extracted page says init(damping, rotspring) but the code defines init(spring, damping, rotspring).
Default values: k = 20, damping = 5, rotk = 3. With an OpenXR session, the up axis stays (0,0,1).

C.desc: Spring filter on the aiming direction.

init.desc: Initializes the spring parameters and forces a direction reset on the next update.

update.desc: Computes data.res.rot from the smoothed direction from data.res.pos to data.res.targetPos.
